text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing training, as I was 
treating Nakayama Festa to some taiyaki—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oho, the raffle.
choice_data_list: Want to give it a shot?

Do you want to try taking on the 
challenge?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, of course. What else would I do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, along with taiyaki, we stocked up 
on drinks and other items at the shopping 
district stores and received raffle 
tickets.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. Then I'll make sure to put that 
one ticket to good use.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa enthusiastically turned the 
lever of the raffle machine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent~! So here is your "Hot Springs 
Trip Ticket"~!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, guess I'll head back.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean... it's just a regular hot 
spring, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Here, Trainer, have this travel 
voucher. Consider it thanks for letting me 
spin the lottery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa shows almost no interest in 
the prize she won.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This hot spring inn is famous as a retreat 
used by top Umamusume, but...
choice_data_list:
I'll decide whether to use it based on 
your results, then.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haaah? My race record?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If you're going abroad with her, you 
should give her a chance to catch her 
breath and rest up before the final 
adjustments."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, on the other hand, if we end up 
with a disastrous result that demands we 
get our act together—there will be no time 
for hot springs.
choice_data_list:
So whether you can use this or not is up 
to you.

So whether you can use this or not is up 
to you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...! Heh-heh... If our training had gone 
off the rails, that hot springs trip 
would've gone down the drain, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Real risk with real return. Now that's a 
wager proposed by someone who knows the 
ropes.
choice_data_list:
That should help fuel your fire a bit, 
right?

That should help fuel your fire a bit, 
wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah. It seems you understand me quite well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a new bet with Nakayama Festa was 
made.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, 1st prize! Today really is my lucky 
day.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, just one? We can't split this 
evenly.
choice_data_list: Since we're here, you should have it!
Since we have it, why don't you eat it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha, well then...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that ain't it. Let's try reading 
between the lines a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"There is one reward, but two people 
present. If so... what should be done?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Now, let's open it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Straight flush! Now, what've you got...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Alright. With this, all the carrot hamburg 
steaks and cup noodles at your place 
belong to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as smooth as could be, she cleaned 
out not just the carrot hamburg steaks, 
but every scrap of food in the house.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Got a nice gloss to it, not bad. Look like 
it'd be tasty grilled just like this, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"This is thanks for the taiyaki from 
earlier, and for letting me spin the 
raffle."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wahahaha...)

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Nakayama's Trainer. Eat up, eat up! 
It's on the house today!

text_block_list.name: Oden Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Of course not. ...Here, Nakayama. Stewed 
carrots for you."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Thanks, pops. Come on, you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The dashi broth here is the best under the 
sun. Eat up.

text_block_list.name: Oden Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
No need to pay, you two. Consider it 
thanks for bringing all those carrots.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Nakayama Festa's regular spot, we have 
them cook up a mountain of carrots. The 
flavor warmed my very soul.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... is that all? Well, green and blue 
balls are pretty much all you ever get.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Well, the point is that similar 
colors tend to come out. You've seen that 
kind of thing at arcades before, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa begins fiddling with the 
prize carrot. Together with her, I made my 
way back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're getting way too down. It's 
usually like this. Feels like a miss 90% 
of the time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. So don't fret over it for 
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite all her complaining, Nakayama 
Festa let out a sigh as well.
